jobs.name: Check every dump
jobs.about: Reads every file in the library and checks its size, its sheet, its archive and, for a CHD, the CHD itself.

jobs.name: Find duplicates
jobs.about: Hashes every file in the library and lists each dump found more than once.

jobs.name: List disc games
jobs.about: Lists the library's disc games, each with its state: converted, changed since, its CHD missing, or not converted.

jobs.name: Convert every disc
jobs.about: Converts each disc game to CHD in the Compressed folder; each is checked three ways and given a package.
ask: Every disc game in the library is converted to CHD. A large library takes hours; Stop ends it after the disc it is on.

jobs.name: Check converted discs
jobs.about: Checks each converted disc again: chdman's verify, every track, and the table of contents.

jobs.name: List packages
jobs.about: Lists every package with its state (ok, moved, missing or changed), and the games no package claims.

jobs.name: Check every package
jobs.about: Hashes each package's game and every file against its manifest.

jobs.name: Make packages
jobs.about: Makes a linked package for each game in the library that has none.
ask: A package is made for each game in the library that has none, linked to the game where it lies.
